page: Microsoft Azure E128as_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Easv7 server family. Powered by the x86_64 architecture, it features a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at 4.5 GHz. The hardware configuration delivers 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, supported by 1024.0 GB of system memory. This yields a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The processor includes L1d cache of 48 KB, L2 cache of 1.0 MB, and L3 cache of 32 MB, alongside advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration.

In benchmark evaluations, the E128as_v7 demonstrates top-tier performance across multiple vectors. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and Geekbench multi-core scores both rank in the top 10% of tested instances. Memory subsystem capabilities are highly competitive, with read-only cached small block bandwidth reaching 12383.33 GB/sec and uncached large block write bandwidth at 199.07 GB/sec. The instance also excels in data processing tasks, achieving top-tier results in Redis SET operations, static web serving throughput, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

This server is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Its high memory density and strong computational capacity make it highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, and heavy data processing pipelines. While the instance lacks local NVMe storage and integrated GPUs, its compatibility with Premium Storage and its top-tier LLM inference speeds for CPU-based models provide a robust foundation for non-GPU analytical tasks and enterprise application hosting.
